description:
Cast Megaton's Fate by paying {5}{R}, targeting the indestructible artifact.
Holding priority, activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Megaton's Fate, with the copy targeting the indestructible artifact.
Resolve the copy of Megaton's Fate, failing to destroy the artifact due to it being indestructible, and creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
